interpretation.fact: Across 26 usable R4/R6 profile pairs (including early kernel-13 comparison), the median AUX stage change is +4.132 ms and the median unaccounted change is -3.694 ms; their combined median change is +0.430 ms.
interpretation.inference: The apparent ~4 ms AUX increase is chiefly a stage-accounting redistribution and should not be reported as a separate ~4 ms frame regression.
interpretation.limit: This arithmetic does not establish equal physical AUX delivery. The R4 captures are from a different run and lack candidate-equivalent runtime controls; timing can include preemption.
interpretation.remaining_signal: The median kernel-stage change is +7.380 ms with range -4.120 to +39.701 ms. Complex_Kaleido_5 profile medians are 17 FPS / 43.923 ms kernel on R6 versus 41 FPS / 4.222 ms on R4. Cause is not isolated.

next_discriminator: Use one exact-artifact, controlled comparison for kernel 0 and the worst kernels with identical runtime controls, reset/warm-up boundary and poll cadence, recording per-frame settings and timestamps. Do not repeat the existing 28-kernel sweep for this candidate.
live_state: The current control model records exact R4 installed and live_mutation_authorized=false; the candidate failed. No soak or acceptance.

facts: This was a separate authorized diagnostic on source commit 911b791, not the later failed 36881ca6 candidate; do not treat it as a matched R4/R6 comparison or direct measurement of 36881ca6.
In the final cumulative 754-sample snapshot, compositor average was 0.992 ms versus 32.214 ms kernel residual; the compositor is about 3.08% of that kernel interval.

With tail capture off, three same-candidate samples still measured 11–13 FPS and 67.8–78.2 ms per frame. Tail capture alone does not explain the low rate, though three samples are too few for a full distribution.

The candidate failed its frozen kernel-0 gate and exact R4 was subsequently read-only confirmed at Matrix brightness 52, AUX brightness 245, with live Matrix-origin AUX DDP. The first settings restore readback reported a mismatch; a later restore/readback verified the R4 identity and brightness values.
limits: Cycle-counter stage timings can include task preemption; the build had FreeRTOS task runtime statistics disabled.
The diagnostic's per-poll audio context omitted slowEnergy, so zero reported audio bands do not prove the audio modulation path was inactive.
No matched R4 capture exists for this diagnostic run; the compositor result cannot establish the cause of the failed R6 release.
follow_on_diagnostic.decision: Do not spend another live attempt or rebuild on compositor removal/hoisting alone; the measured compositor cost is too small to explain the failure. Continue offline attribution against the exact failed 36881ca6 source and preserve the frozen gates.

candidate_source.diagnostic_selector: diagnosticSelectKernel() sets variant_.kernel=kernel and variant_.signature=0x504b2000u | kernel
candidate_source.generated_variant_behavior: chooseVariant() first stores generator signature and base fields, then maps profile/style/speed/amount/hueOffset/transform from current Vibe/audio axes; diagnosticSelectKernel() replaces the signature field with the fixed kernel marker.

profile_set.captured_fields: kernel id/name and variant_id marker; per-frame generated base signature and final mapped variant parameters are absent from these profile summaries.

variant_id_interpretation.interpretation: The 26/26 equality proves that each candidate/R4 pair was assigned the same requested kernel in the diagnostic sweep. Because variant_id is overwritten with the fixed marker, it does not prove equal randomly generated base settings, equal Vibe/audio-mapped settings, or equal runtime work. The R4 field is a recorded profile value; exact R4 source was not used to assert implementation semantics.
variant_id_interpretation.decision: Do not use equal variant_id values to rule out variant/settings mismatch as a cause. Existing evidence still does not isolate why the failed candidate has higher kernel cost.
variant_id_interpretation.next_discriminator: For any future authorized diagnostic, capture the actual generated base signature, final mapped speed/profile/style/amount/hueOffset/transform, Vibe/audio feature inputs, and per-frame timing together. The current profile IDs cannot supply those fields. No live action is authorized by the current control state.

compositor_source_comparability.diagnostic_timer: The 911b791 diagnostic timer wraps the composeVibeColor() call in FoundationAnimartrix::writePixel().
compositor_source_comparability.candidate_call: The failed candidate calls the same composeVibeColor() helper from FoundationAnimartrix::writePixel(); the hbnf_vibe_runtime.h implementation is byte-identical.
compositor_source_comparability.other_module_differences: Among the 14 usermod files, only the main usermod source and hbnf_animartrix_audio_bridge.h differ between these two source trees. The bridge change adds a per-pixel inactive fast-path guard and moves radial-coordinate work inside the bass-only branch. It reduces work on inactive/non-bass pixels, while adding a small branch check on active pixels; it does not add a new expensive per-pixel calculation.
limits: The 0.992 ms measurement is direct for the diagnostic artifact and identical helper implementation, but not a direct timing of the failed candidate. Input Vibe/audio axes, selected generated parameters, and scheduler interruption may differ.

The candidate main source changed extensively and the sweep does not capture final mapped variant settings. The unchanged helper hash therefore rules against treating a compositor rewrite alone as a proven fix; it does not identify the kernel-stage cause.
compositor_source_comparability.decision: Do not spend another candidate attempt removing/hoisting composeVibeColor alone. The remaining performance attribution is in the animation kernel under unrecorded final settings, other main-source changes, or execution/preemption; current evidence does not distinguish them.
